decisions.briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.0% and S&P 500 down 1.1%, putting us in a risk-off environment. No new candidates were screened, so we're holding our 7 existing positions and preserving cash rather than forcing a buy.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices fell today, with tech-heavy NASDAQ underperforming the broader S&P 500, signaling broad risk-off sentiment among investors. No specific company or macro headlines were available in today's feed to pinpoint an exact catalyst. In risk-off conditions like this, capital tends to rotate out of growth and higher-beta names into safer assets.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍下跌，科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅達2.0%，表現遜於標普500指數的1.1%跌幅，反映市場情緒偏向避險。今日消息來源中未提供具體的公司或宏觀新聞標題，暫無法確定明確導火線。在這種風險偏好轉弱的環境下，資金往往會從成長股及高波動性股票流向較安全的資產。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day means investors are broadly selling riskier assets like growth stocks and moving toward safety. When this happens, it's often better to hold existing positions and avoid adding new ones until conditions stabilize, rather than chasing a falling market.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好轉弱」（Risk-Off）是指投資者普遍拋售成長股等風險較高的資產，轉向較安全的資產。遇到這種情況時，通常較好的做法是持有現有倉位、暫緩加碼新股，等市況穩定後再行動，而非追逐下跌的市場。
